title: Google reports first verifiable quantum advantage with Quantum Echoes on Willow
summary: Google published in Nature an OTOC-based algorithm, Quantum Echoes, run on its Willow chip, reporting a 13,000x speedup over the best classical algorithm on a top supercomputer.
source_title: Our Quantum Echoes algorithm is a big step toward real-world applications for quantum computing
excerpt: Just published in Nature, we have demonstrated the first-ever verifiable quantum advantage running the out-of-order time correlator (OTOC) algorithm, which we call Quantum Echoes.

title: Atom Computing selected for next stage of DARPA QBI
summary: Atom Computing was selected by DARPA to proceed to the next stage of the Quantum Benchmarking Initiative after its earlier Stage A selection.
source_title: Atom Computing selected by DARPA for the next stage of exploring near-term utility-scale quantum computing with neutral atoms
excerpt: Atom Computing has been selected by the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) to proceed to the next stage of exploring how Atom's highly-scalable neutral atom technology will realize utility-scale quantum computing in the near term.

title: IBM unveils Quantum Nighthawk and experimental Quantum Loon processors
summary: IBM announced the 120-qubit Nighthawk processor aimed at quantum advantage and the experimental Loon processor demonstrating components needed for fault tolerance.
source_title: IBM Delivers New Quantum Processors, Software, and Algorithm Breakthroughs on Path to Advantage and Fault Tolerance
excerpt: The company is announcing IBM Quantum Loon, its experimental processor that, for the first time, shows that IBM has demonstrated all the key processor components needed for fault-tolerant quantum computing.

title: Microsoft adds chemistry and error-correction tools to its Quantum Development Kit
summary: Microsoft announced new developer tools for the Microsoft Quantum platform, including domain libraries for chemistry and error correction.
source_title: Powerful new developer tools increase the versatility of the Microsoft Quantum platform
excerpt: The field of quantum computing has advanced beyond the level of error-prone physical qubits to an era of reliable quantum computation with logical qubits.

title: PsiQuantum names Victor Peng interim CEO; O'Brien becomes executive chairman
summary: PsiQuantum appointed former AMD president Victor Peng as interim CEO, with co-founder Jeremy O'Brien moving to executive chairman.
source_title: PsiQuantum Appoints Victor Peng as Interim CEO, Co-Founder Jeremy O'Brien to Become Executive Chairman
excerpt: PsiQuantum today announced the appointment of Victor Peng, a veteran of the computing industry and former President at Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD), as Interim Chief Executive Officer

title: Rigetti Cepheus-1-108Q becomes generally available on Amazon Braket
summary: AWS reported that Rigetti's 108-qubit superconducting Cepheus-1-108Q QPU became generally available on Amazon Braket on April 7, 2026.
source_title: Amazon Braket launches Rigetti Cepheus™-1-108Q superconducting device
excerpt: On April 7, 2026, we expanded the hardware available on Braket with the general availability of Rigetti Computing's Cepheus-1-108Q, a 108-qubit superconducting quantum processing unit (QPU).

title: IBM commits more than $10 billion to quantum computing over five years
summary: IBM announced plans to invest more than $10 billion in quantum computing over five years across R&D, capex, manufacturing, partnerships and M&A.
source_title: IBM Commits More Than $10 Billion to Quantum Computing, Funding Its Roadmap from Today's Leading Systems to the World's First Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computers
excerpt: IBM (NYSE: IBM) has announced plans to invest more than $10 billion in quantum computing over the next five years.

title: Microsoft unveils Majorana 2 topological quantum processor
summary: Microsoft announced Majorana 2, stating its qubits are 1,000x more reliable than those in its previous quantum processing unit. Date taken from the Microsoft Quantum blog listing.
source_title: Microsoft Azure Quantum Blog
excerpt: Majorana 2 contains qubits that are 1,000x more reliable than those in our previous quantum processing unit.

title: Alice & Bob unveils Helium, its first full quantum system
summary: Alice & Bob unveiled the Helium Quantum System for on-premise deployment, engineered to encode its first logical qubit with as few as 18 cat qubits.
source_title: Alice & Bob Unveils First Quantum System Available for Research Partners
excerpt: today unveiled the Helium Quantum System, marking the expansion from developing cat-qubit chips to delivering a complete quantum computing system for on-premise deployment.

title: Atom Computing raises over $300M including $100M Series C
summary: Atom Computing said it has raised more than $300 million to date, including a $100 million Series C led by Third Point Ventures and a planned $100 million from the U.S. Department of Commerce.
source_title: Atom Computing Raises More Than $300 Million to Accelerate Deployment of Fault-Tolerant, Neutral-Atom Quantum Computers
excerpt: Atom Computing has raised over $300 million to date, including a $100 million Series C round led by Third Point Ventures and a planned $100 million from the U.S. Department of Commerce

title: PsiQuantum breaks ground on utility-scale quantum computer site in Australia
summary: PsiQuantum began construction at Moreton Bay Central, Queensland, where it plans to build and deploy a utility-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computer.
source_title: PsiQuantum Breaks Ground in Australia on Site of World's First Utility-Scale Quantum Computer
excerpt: PsiQuantum today broke ground and started construction on its facility at Moreton Bay Central, where the company will build and deploy the world's first utility-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computer.

title: PsiQuantum signs $125M expanded agreement with DARPA under QBI
summary: PsiQuantum signed a $125 million expanded agreement with DARPA under the Quantum Benchmarking Initiative and remains one of two companies in Stage C.
source_title: PsiQuantum Signs $125 Million Agreement with DARPA
excerpt: PsiQuantum today announced that the company has signed a new $125 million expanded agreement with the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) under DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI)

title: IBM agrees to acquire HRL Laboratories
summary: IBM signed a definitive agreement to acquire HRL Laboratories, the research institution jointly owned by Boeing and General Motors; deal value was not disclosed.
source_title: IBM to Acquire HRL Laboratories to Power the Future of Quantum
excerpt: IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire HRL Laboratories, LLC (HRL), a flagship research and development institution.

title: IBM and Algorithmiq claim quantum advantage in materials simulation
summary: IBM and Algorithmiq announced a joint quantum advantage demonstration simulating a heterogeneous quantum material, with a framework for trusting results without classical verification.
source_title: IBM and Algorithmiq Demonstrate Quantum Advantage, Establishing a Framework for Trusted Quantum Computation Beyond Classical Verification
excerpt: Today, Algorithmiq and IBM (NYSE: IBM) announced a major milestone in the development of quantum computing: a joint demonstration of quantum advantage with the simulation of a heterogeneous quantum material

title: D-Wave reports high-fidelity two-qubit gate for dual-rail qubits in Nature
summary: D-Wave announced research published in Nature demonstrating a fast, high-fidelity two-qubit entangling gate on its superconducting dual-rail qubit architecture.
source_title: D-Wave Demonstrates Major Hardware Breakthrough for Quantum Error Correction, Advancing the Path to Practical, Fault-Tolerant Gate-Model Quantum Computing
excerpt: Published in the peer-reviewed scientific journal Nature, the research demonstrates a fast, high-fidelity, two-qubit entangling gate that preserves the error-correction advantages of D-Wave's superconducting dual-rail qubit architecture.

title: Quantinuum partners with Quanta Computer on quantum manufacturing foundation
summary: Quantinuum and Quanta Computer plan to co-develop infrastructure, systems engineering and manufacturing capabilities for future quantum computers.
source_title: Quanta Computer and Quantinuum Partner to Build an Industrial Foundation for Large-Scale Quantum Computing
excerpt: Companies plan to co-develop the infrastructure, systems engineering, and manufacturing capabilities required for future generations of quantum computers.

title: IBM joins and cools two cryogenic modules into one environment
summary: IBM announced it connected and cooled two cryogenic modules into a single environment, a step toward linking many quantum chips.
source_title: IBM Connects Its First Modular Cryogenic Systems in Milestone Toward Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing
excerpt: IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced it has successfully joined and cooled down two cryogenic modules into a single environment.

title: Atom Computing appoints Kevin Messerle as CFO
summary: Atom Computing named Kevin Messerle Chief Financial Officer as it scales operations.
source_title: Atom Computing Appoints Kevin Messerle as Chief Financial Officer
excerpt: Atom Computing, a leader in the race to build practical quantum computers, today announced the appointment of Kevin Messerle as Chief Financial Officer.

title: Quantinuum signs non-binding MOU with Aramco
summary: Quantinuum and Aramco signed a non-binding MOU to explore industrial quantum use cases and a potential fault-tolerant research collaboration.
source_title: Quantinuum Signs Non-binding MOU with Aramco to Explore Synergies Leveraging Industrial Quantum Computing Research, Applications, and Expertise
excerpt: Under the MOU, the companies intend to undertake preliminary technical onboarding and engage in knowledge exchange activities.

title: D-Wave finalizes up to $100M CHIPS Act agreement with U.S. Commerce
summary: D-Wave executed a definitive agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce, following an earlier letter of intent, giving it access to up to $100 million in CHIPS Act funding.
source_title: D-Wave Quantum Finalizes Definitive Agreement with U.S. Department of Commerce for Up to $100 Million to Accelerate U.S. Leadership in Quantum Computing
excerpt: D-Wave now has access to up to $100 million of U.S. CHIPS and Science Act funding.

title: Quantinuum finalizes $100M CHIPS R&D award with US Commerce
summary: Quantinuum finalized a $100 million CHIPS R&D award to advance US trapped-ion quantum computer manufacturing, partnering with GlobalFoundries and Monarch Quantum.
source_title: Quantinuum Finalizes $100 Million CHIPS R&D Award with U.S. Department of Commerce to Advance Trapped-Ion Quantum Computer Manufacturing in the US
excerpt: The federal funding supports critical R&D and U.S. quantum semiconductor manufacturing capabilities needed to scale fault-tolerant trapped-ion quantum computing.

title: QCi signs three-year framework agreement with Hamad Bin Khalifa University
summary: QCi signed a three-year framework agreement with HBKU in Qatar to collaborate on quantum computing, sensing and communications.
source_title: Quantum Computing Inc. Expands Global Quantum Adoption Through New Hamad Bin Khalifa University Framework Agreement
excerpt: today announced it has signed a three-year Framework Agreement with Hamad Bin Khalifa University, Qatar (HBKU) to collaborate in quantum computing, quantum sensing, and quantum communications.

title: IBM's Anderon finalizes $1B CHIPS award for US quantum foundry
summary: Anderon, an IBM company, finalized a $1 billion CHIPS and Science Act award with the US Department of Commerce for quantum wafer manufacturing R&D.
source_title: Anderon, an IBM Company, Finalizes Agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce for a $1 Billion CHIPS Award to Accelerate R&D for U.S.-Based Pure-Play Quantum Foundry
excerpt: The award will accelerate Anderon's R&D efforts to advance the nation's quantum wafer manufacturing capabilities.

title: Pasqal marks Nasdaq public listing under ticker PSQL
summary: Pasqal announced it would ring the Nasdaq Closing Bell to mark its recent public listing under the ticker PSQL; the release does not state the listing mechanism or capital raised.
source_title: Pasqal to Ring Nasdaq Closing Bell on September 17
excerpt: today announced that it will ring the Nasdaq Closing Bell on September 17, 2026, marking the Company's recent public listing under the ticker symbol NASDAQ: PSQL.

title: QuEra collaborates with HPE on on-premises fault-tolerant quantum-HPC
summary: QuEra announced a collaboration with HPE to integrate neutral-atom fault-tolerant quantum computing with HPE Cray-powered HPC environments.
source_title: QuEra Computing Collaborates with HPE to Bring Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing to On-Premises HPC Environments
excerpt: QuEra Computing, the leader in neutral-atom quantum computing, today announced a collaboration with HPE to integrate neutral-atom, fault-tolerant quantum computing with on-premise high-performance computing (HPC) environments powered by the HPE Cray supercomputing platform.

title: IonQ demonstrates real-time QEC decoder on a single standard CPU
summary: IonQ announced an end-to-end real-time quantum error correction decoder running on a single off-the-shelf CPU.
source_title: IonQ Demonstrates Industry's First End-to-End Real-Time Quantum Error Decoder
excerpt: Researchers demonstrated the development and successful testing of the industry's first end-to-end real-time quantum error correction decoder that runs on a single standard off-the-shelf central processing unit (CPU).

title: IonQ to deliver Superion 256-qubit system to Florida International University
summary: IonQ announced a contract to deliver its Superion 256-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer for installation at FIU.
source_title: IonQ | FIU Secures Florida's First IonQ Superion Quantum System
excerpt: Under the agreement, IonQ will deliver its Superion 256-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer for installation at FIU.

title: Pasqal exits French defense program LSQUARE (PROQCIMA)
summary: Pasqal said it is refocusing its collaboration with French public authorities on commercial applications, including ending its participation in the LSQUARE (PROQCIMA) defense program.
source_title: Pasqal Announces an Evolution of Its Collaboration Framework with the French Public Authorities
excerpt: This evolution includes the termination of Pasqal's participation in the defense program LSQUARE (otherwise known as PROQCIMA), to which Pasqal participated in its first phase and successfully completed all the technological objectives.

title: D-Wave launches gate-model simulator beta program
summary: D-Wave launched a beta program giving select customers early access to its gate-model quantum computing simulator ahead of general availability.
source_title: D-Wave Launches Gate-Model Simulator Beta Program, Advancing Error-Aware Programming Capabilities
excerpt: today launched its gate-model quantum computing simulator beta program, marking an important milestone in D-Wave's gate-model development roadmap.

title: Pasqal appoints Florence Lao as Chief Legal Officer
summary: Pasqal named Florence Lao Chief Legal Officer, advising its executive team and board as a publicly traded company.
source_title: Pasqal Appoints Florence Lao as Chief Legal Officer
excerpt: Pasqal (NASDAQ: PSQL), a global leader in neutral-atom quantum computing, today announced the appointment of Florence Lao as Chief Legal Officer.

title: QCi announces Dirac-3S optimization system scaling to ~10,000 variables
summary: QCi announced Dirac-3S, scaling quantum optimization to nearly 10,000 variables, with first customer shipment of the upgrade expected in Q4 2026.
source_title: Quantum Computing Inc. Announces Dirac-3S, Scaling to Nearly 10,000 Variables
excerpt: Scales quantum optimization to up to nearly 10,000 variables, a 10x increase over QCi's current 1,000-variable system, while delivering faster performance, production-ready reliability and scalable manufacturing. First customer shipment of Dirac-3S upgrade expected in Q4 2026.

title: Atom Computing advances to final stage of DARPA QBI
summary: DARPA selected Atom Computing for the final stage of the Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, a stage with potential funding of up to $300 million.
source_title: Atom Computing Selected by DARPA for Final Stage of Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
excerpt: This stage, with potential funding of up to $300 million, reinforces the momentum behind Atom Computing's vision and roadmap for building a utility-scale quantum computer using neutral-atom quantum technology.

title: IBM selected for Stage C of DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
summary: IBM announced its selection for Stage C, the third phase of DARPA's QBI, for independent verification of its fault-tolerance approach.
source_title: IBM Advances to Stage C of DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
excerpt: IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced it has been selected for Stage C, the third phase of the Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI) led by DARPA

title: IonQ advances to DARPA QBI Stage C under agreement worth up to $300M
summary: IonQ said it will advance to Stage C of DARPA's QBI under an agreement with a potential value of up to $300 million.
source_title: IonQ Advances to Final Stage of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative
excerpt: Under an agreement with a potential value of up to $300 million, IonQ will advance to Stage C of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative.

title: PsiQuantum gets conditional $150M loan commitment from DoW OSC
summary: PsiQuantum received a conditional commitment for a loan of up to $150 million from the Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital to expand U.S. manufacturing and prototyping.
source_title: PsiQuantum Receives Conditional $150 Million Loan Commitment from the U.S. Department of War to Advance Domestic Quantum Computing
excerpt: PsiQuantum announced today that the company has received a conditional commitment for a loan of up to $150 million from the U.S. Department of War's Office of Strategic Capital (OSC)

title: IonQ reports 1 kHz ion-to-quantum-memory photonic interconnect
summary: IonQ reported a photonic interconnect generating more than 1,000 entangled connections per second between a trapped-ion qubit and a silicon vacancy quantum memory.
source_title: IonQ Demonstrates World-First Quantum Memory-Enhanced Interconnect for Distributed Quantum Applications
excerpt: Photonic interconnect generates more than 1,000 quantum connections per second between a trapped ion qubit and a silicon vacancy quantum memory.

title: IonQ to acquire Elisity in all-stock deal valued up to $1.3B
summary: IonQ agreed to acquire Zero Trust security company Elisity in an all-stock transaction valued at up to $1.3 billion.
source_title: IonQ to Acquire Elisity to Accelerate Zero Trust for the Quantum Era
excerpt: today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Elisity, Inc., a Zero Trust security company, in an all-stock transaction valued at up to $1.3 billion.

title: SkyWater and D-Wave sign multi-year quantum manufacturing agreement
summary: SkyWater Technology and D-Wave announced a multi-year agreement extending their partnership on semiconductor process development and manufacturing for D-Wave's roadmap.
source_title: SkyWater and D-Wave Extend Quantum Manufacturing Collaboration Through Multi-Year Agreement
excerpt: This collaboration extends the long-established partnership between both companies, to continue specialized semiconductor process development and manufacturing in support of D-Wave's quantum technology roadmap.

title: D-Wave Advantage2 system arrives in Como, Italy for installation
summary: D-Wave said its Advantage2 annealing quantum computer, funded by Swiss Quantum Technology SA, arrived in Lombardy for installation at Villa Saporiti in Como.
source_title: D-Wave Delivers Italy's First Annealing Quantum Computer
excerpt: today announced at Digital Innovation Forum 2026 that its Advantage2™ annealing quantum computer has arrived in Lombardy, Italy, for installation at Villa Saporiti in Como.

title: QuEra joins three ARPA-E QC3 quantum chemistry teams
summary: QuEra said its scientists will work with three of the nine teams selected for ARPA-E's Quantum Computing for Computational Chemistry (QC3) program.
source_title: QuEra Scientists Named Co-Principal Investigators on Three of Nine Teams in Department of Energy's Quantum Chemistry Program, Now Underway
excerpt: today announced that its scientists will work with three of the nine teams selected for the Quantum Computing for Computational Chemistry (QC3) program at the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Energy (ARPA-E)
